activity.notes: Wilhelm I was proclaimed the first German Emperor at Versailles on 18 January 1871 and remained German Emperor until his death on 9 March 1888. ATLAS binds this sovereign Activity to the German Empire rather than modern Germany because the federal imperial state founded in 1871 is the historically specific polity relevant to this office. His concurrent kingship of Prussia is historically distinct and is not duplicated in this registration.

sources.title: LeMO Biografie — Wilhelm I.
sources.citation_text: The Deutsches Historisches Museum records Wilhelm I's proclamation as Emperor of the newly founded German Empire on 18 January 1871 and his death on 9 March 1888.

sources.title: Kaiserreich und Erster Weltkrieg — Deutsches Historisches Museum
sources.citation_text: The Deutsches Historisches Museum describes the German Empire as a constitutional-monarchical federal state founded in 1871 and identifies the Prussian king Wilhelm I as its head of state and German Emperor.
